Future registry/adapter composition therefore requires re-review; current lender-only conclusions do not assume immutable future strategies.

reviews.rationale: The canonical Plasma syzUSD vault holds yzUSD directly. At block 33932322 its yzUSD balance minus pending redemptions and deterministically unvested funded distributions equals totalAssets exactly. Verified V3 and inherited V1/V2 source expose share issuance against deposits, redemptions, funded yield distribution, pause/settings and upgrade administration, not a borrowing or strategy-allocation surface. Underlying-token rescue is forbidden while shares are outstanding; termination can withdraw only undistributed yield. yzUSD portfolio leverage, third-party strategy reuse and custody remain upstream serial-parent risks. Live upgrades and CCIP token-pool escrow remain separate reviewed control/bridge exposures.
